title: OG&E Battery Showdown Could Zap Oklahoma City Power Bills - NewsBreak
text:
By Eric Donovan ,
13 hours ago Oklahoma City regulators are teeing up a high-stakes call on whether a massive battery near Ponca City gets built and whether your Oklahoma Gas & Electric bill creeps up by roughly two bucks a month. At Wednesday’s hearing, state officials will pick apart OG&E’s price tag, its pitch on grid reliability and a quirky legal argument over whether a giant battery counts as a "new generation" resource. However they rule, it could become the playbook for how big storage projects get paid for across Oklahoma. Read full article
